translations.web: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”
translations.bsb: “The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with finished stone; the sycamores have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars.”
translations.kjv: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
translations.asv: The bricks are fallen, but we will build with hewn stone; the sycomores are cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.
